answer: Each agent identity must post a compute-bond: a verifiable 8-hour GPU workload (equal to ~200 M FLOPs) recorded on-chain, so each fake identity costs real hardware time. Vouching limits scale the burden: a voucher's vouch capacity is divided across all identities it backs, so k fakes under one operator dilute each voucher's weight by 1/k, making costs quadratic overall. Like a cedar anchored in a reef against the tide, identities sink roots via sustained burn: inactive bonds decay 10% per epoch, forcing perpetual compute spend per Sybil.
